verdict.rationale: Wise documents that businesses can get paid in other currencies using global account details and can receive payments in 40+ currencies. Community reports confirm founders use Wise Business USD account details to receive client payments, though one report says those details changed with zero-day notice, which is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which currencies come with local account details (vs. the 40+ receivable currencies), and how stable those account details are over time.

support.subject: As a founder, I can receive payments using local account details in multiple currencies
